paper_diagnosis: A Rare Case of Measles-Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis in an Infant
disease_label_per_paper: Measles-associated pneumonitis complicated by hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in a 4-month-old infant

demographics.ethnicity_or_context: infant below routine measles vaccination age

presentation_summary: 4-month-old boy was admitted with severe respiratory distress due to measles-associated pneumonitis 9 days after disease onset.
He was febrile and in poor general condition, with respiratory rate 70/min and oxygen saturation 93-94%.
Physical examination showed diffuse crackles and wheezing in both lungs and a generalized erythematous maculopapular rash.
Koplik spots, conjunctivitis, lymphadenopathy, and hepatosplenomegaly were absent at admission.
Initial laboratory data were reported as normal, and blood cultures were negative.
Measles IgM was detected and measles infection was diagnosed; chest radiography showed mild infiltration without signs of pneumonia.
He was given oxygen, nebulized racemic epinephrine, and intravenous cefotaxime because bacterial coinfection and sepsis could not be excluded.
Five days later he had persistent fever and respiratory distress, and ultrasound showed hepatosplenomegaly.
HLH evaluation showed ferritin around 10000 ng/mL, hypofibrinogenemia, hypertriglyceridemia, cytopenias, high LDH, hepatitis, and bone-marrow hemophagocytosis without malignant blasts.
He was successfully treated with intravenous dexamethasone and intravenous immunoglobulin.

quality_warnings: The report states initial laboratory results were normal but gives detailed later table values; early normal values are preserved narratively and not numerically imputed.
Cough is not quoted as a presenting symptom; respiratory illness is encoded mainly through dyspnea, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, wheezing, crackles, and pneumonitis.
Chest X-ray was mild and did not show radiographic pneumonia despite clinical measles pneumonitis; both facts are preserved.
HLH is encoded as an event hazard axis and supporting HLH labs rather than as a separate expected disease manifold for this case.
